Name: Sukey the Tuxedo Cat
Author: EgotisticalSlug
Description:
[center][size=2][b][size=5][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8926/8926-1711504401-1801413323.gif[/img]﻿

Description:[/size][/b][/size]

A simple cat retexture mod that changes the appearance of the default black cat to a black and white tuxedo cat with unique markings. Based on my IRL cat, Sukey.[/center]



[b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/b]

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to work. Please make sure these are installed before completing the following steps.

[list=1]
[*]Unzip the folder.
[*]Locate your Mods folder for Stardew Valley. (For Steam, you can do this by right-clicking on the game in your Library and going to Manage > Browse Local Files.)
[*]Drag the unzipped folder "[CP] Sukey the Tuxedo Cat" into the Mods folder.
[*]Done.
[/list]


[b][size=5]Latest changes:[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]slightly changed colours
[*]replaces the default black cat instead of the grey and white tabby
[*]updated minimum version requirement to 1.6
[/list]
